metadata.title: AlfarisTech — AI, Dev & Education Solutions
metadata.description: Faris Alkrenawi — Software Engineer & AI Specialist. Building production-grade AI systems, mobile apps, and web platforms for healthcare, fintech, IoT, and beyond.

hero.name: Faris Alkrenawi
hero.description: I build production-grade AI systems, mobile apps, and web platforms that solve real-world problems in healthcare, fintech, IoT, and beyond. Currently engineering the backend of Netafim's precision-irrigation IoT platform.

about.label: About Me
about.title: Building Intelligent Software That Makes a
about.p1: I'm a Computer Science student at Ben-Gurion University (B.Sc. expected 2027), having transferred from Mathematics at the Technion — Israel Institute of Technology. My passion lies at the intersection of AI and real-world impact.
about.p2: Currently a Software Engineering Intern at Siraj, contributing to Netafim's Adaptive Drip System — a precision-irrigation IoT platform controlling thousands of valves. Certified in AI by The;Institute (with BGU, NVIDIA & Microsoft), I specialize in LLMs, RAG architectures, and ML models. Six years tutoring 200+ students gives me a unique ability to translate complex technology into clear, actionable solutions.

siraj.desc: Contributing to the backend of Netafim's Adaptive Drip System — a precision-irrigation IoT platform controlling thousands of valves across multi-layer optical networks (L0/L1/L2) connecting field nodes, lateral controllers, and gateways. Building end-to-end integration tests in Java/Spring Boot with Cucumber BDD, validating the plan calculation engine, constraint enforcement, and runtime state consistency across MongoDB and SQL stores.

freelance.desc: Building custom software for clients across mobile and web — from idea to App Store deployment. Recent work includes Nawaqeet (1,000+ active users) and a Client Management System for an engineering firm.

tutor.desc: Tutored 200+ students at university and high school levels in advanced mathematics and physics. Developed the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable understanding — a skill that now shapes how I write code, documentation, and client communication.

ai.title: AI & Machine Learning
ai.desc: Custom ML models, RAG systems, and LLM integrations for intelligent decision-making. From clinical prediction to financial analysis.

mobile.title: Mobile Development
mobile.desc: Cross-platform iOS & Android apps built with Flutter and Firebase. From concept to App Store deployment with real-time backends.

web.title: Web Applications
web.desc: Full-stack web development with modern frameworks. Responsive, performant, and scalable platforms tailored to your business needs.

education.title: Tech Education
education.desc: University-level tutoring in mathematics, physics, and computer science. Complex concepts explained clearly, with 200+ students trained.

consulting.title: AI Consulting
consulting.desc: Strategic guidance on integrating AI into your workflows. Prompt engineering, agent architectures, and vector embedding strategies.

devops.title: DevOps & Cloud
devops.desc: Containerized deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. Ensuring your applications are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

oncorisk.title: OncoRisk EC — Clinical Decision Support
oncorisk.desc: Production system for Soroka Medical Center predicting endometrial cancer risk. XGBoost ensemble with SHAP explainability, FastAPI backend, Next.js 14 frontend, Dockerized deployment. Won hackathon award as sole developer; received initial approval from the hospital's medical board to advance into joint development with Soroka's internal engineering team.

nawaqeet.title: Nawaqeet — Event Management Platform
nawaqeet.desc: Event management platform published on iOS & Android, reaching 1,000+ active users. Manages transaction records (community gift tracking), wedding announcements, and a vendor directory of photographers, venues, and catering.

netobox.title: NetoBox — Invoice Management System
netobox.desc: Smart invoice management with live Israeli tax calculations and automated receipt generation. Streamlines financial workflows for freelancers and businesses.

engineer.title: Client Management System
engineer.desc: Full client tracking and document-management platform for an engineering firm. Authentication, role-based access, and document storage on Firebase — deployed and in active client use.

rag.title: Financial Hybrid RAG System
rag.desc: Hybrid retrieval pipeline combining dense vector search (FAISS embeddings) with keyword-based retrieval over financial documents, orchestrated with LangChain and LLM-based synthesis for rapid, context-aware results.

lae.title: Linear Algebra Computation Engine
lae.desc: Multi-threaded matrix-operations engine in Java. Implements concurrency primitives, parallelism, synchronization, and explicit locking — built to explore how classical numerical workloads scale under shared-memory contention.

dj.title: DJ Session Tracker
dj.desc: Music-session management system in C++ focusing on manual memory management, RAII patterns, and efficient data structures for real-time session state tracking.

carnotify.title: CarNotify — Driver Alert System
carnotify.desc: Vehicle monitoring app for critical safety alerts — lights on, door open, and child detection. Designed to prevent accidents and currently pending regulatory approval.
